identity.title: Common Cause Inoperability of Engineered Safety Features

cause.proximate_text: VCSNS identified that Door DRCB/501, located between the Control Building and Turbine Building on the 463' elevation, was closed, but not latching properly. DRCB/501 is a SPB credited to mitigate postulated high energy line breaks in the Turbine Building and is relied upon to support OPERABILITY of ESF equipment located in the Control Building.
cause.theme: steam propagation barrier door failed to latch, degrading its high-energy line break mitigation function

nodes.display_name: DRCB/501 door closed but not latching properly
nodes.description: Door was closed but failed to latch, degrading the steam propagation barrier function.
Without proper latching, the SPB could not be relied upon to mitigate a postulated high energy line break in the Turbine Building.

nodes.display_name: Both trains of ESF equipment in Control Building declared inoperable
Repair DRCB/501 latch and restore ESF equipment to OPERABLE
Further corrective actions per CR1269095 to be provided in supplemental report
